action.objective: Play c2c4 to expand on the queenside and pressure Black's bishop, keeping the queen active on b5.
action.rationale: c2c4 is the only commit_ready move: verified depth 3, exact -4, safety complete with no mate-in-one and tactical_refutation not_found.
